notes.title: 2023-10-10 - Minor PC Version 1.04 Patch
notes.content:
Hey Doods,

We've released an update for [i]Disgaea 7: Vows of the Virtueless[/i] to address crashing issues with the game:

[list]
[*] [b]For players unable to play the game after selecting Full Screen[/b], it'll now give you an error message and revert to Windowed mode instead of closing. Additionally, fixed a crash that can occur if you try to select a full screen resolution from the list when the functionality isn't supported.
[*] [b]For players unable to play the game after version 1.02's update[/b], fixed an issue with language selection that was preventing the game from starting properly.
[*] Fixed a problem in which Evilities referring to elements were not applying to composite elements.
[*] Fixed possible slowdowns when loading files, which may improve performance during some effects.
[/list]

Please continue to discuss issues you may have in our Troubleshooting forum.

Thank you for all of the feedback so far.

notes.title: 2023-10-06 - Minor PC Version 1.02 Patch
notes.content:
Hey Doods,

We've released a small update for [i]Disgaea 7: Vows of the Virtueless[/i] to address a couple more issues with the game:

[list]
[*] Correct order that settings are saved so that you can't become unable to open the game. There was an issue with this taking effect in 1.01. Sorry for the inconvenience!
[list]
[*] [b]If you are currently receiving the "Failed to resize the window size." error,[/b] please use the following instructions to reset your PC-specific settings:
[olist][*] Open in Windows Explorer: %appdata%\Nippon Ichi Software, Inc\Disgaea 7\
[*] Delete the file: setting.ini
[/olist][*] This will not affect your game progress or gameplay-related settings.
[*] Please note that we're still investigating this error's root cause. If it affects you, try setting your [b]Window Type[/b] to [b]Borderless[/b] instead of [b]Full Screen[/b].
[/list][*] Fixed an issue where Geo Symbol destruction and similar repeating sound effects could overlap and become louder than intended at high frame rates, with fast mode enabled, or with skip modes enabled.
[*] Fixed the display of certain skills under certain Wickedhancements. Elements should now be reported correctly when it would previously appear as None.
[*] Fixed the first-launch of the game not checking your Steam language and always starting in English.
[/list]

Please continue to report any issues in our Troubleshooting forum.

Thank you for all of the feedback so far.

notes.title: Disgaea 7: Vows of the Virtueless - Steam Version Features
notes.content:
Hello, Doods!

We’re very excited that [i][b]Disgaea 7: Vows of the Virtueless[/b][/i] releases today! For console as well as PC players, the development team has worked hard to provide a version that can be enjoyed by everyone. Unique considerations have been made for playing the game on PC so that it works on decked-out rigs, the portable Steam Deck, and everything else in between.

Here are a few features specific to the PC version:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43569151/5eb4e8be6fcaa891ecbcbb91dd56f0f8257f4e9e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43569151/ad1a473057170390143c66082ad5dd6f4ac98490.jpg[/img]

[h2]Arbitrary Aspect Ratio: Steam Deck & Ultrawide Support[/h2]

The game scales to any aspect ratio. This has been tested from 21:9 to 4:3, but should also work well on any display in between, including the venerable Steam Deck’s 16:10 display!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43569151/13a335d6057d030beaa506d65aa224abfd31ee2c.png[/img]

[h2]4K Resolution[/h2]

Enjoy the visuals of the Netherworld in high quality!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43569151/d78292940947ad265ee92d1323e5916e317d9116.png[/img]

[h2]Keyboard and Mouse Control Support[/h2]

The keyboard and mouse can be used to control the game menus, select targets in battle, or even click on the on-screen button guides! Of course, controller support is extended to any type you might use!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43569151/bbf2f0f0c6cd6257ffa2c89bb72a6298e0753b69.png[/img]

[h2]Additional Graphics Options[/h2]

Advanced graphics settings can be used to optimize your experience for your particular hardware setup!


With 45 character classes (including 4 new classes) and new features such as Item Reincarnation, Hell Mode, and Jumbification, this is the biggest [i]Disgaea[/i] game yet! Dive into the mayhem by visiting the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2250600/Disgaea_7_Vows_of_the_Virtueless/][u]Steam page[/u][/url], and enjoy special launch discounts on the Deluxe Edition and Ultimate Edition until [b]October 16[/b], dood!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2250600/Disgaea_7_Vows_of_the_Virtueless/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43569151/8fba986132afbf71362a32f0be1070cf7c4d029c.jpg[/img][/url]

Thanks for reading, dood!
